description: Signal type classification for collection variables

items.label: Analog Input
items.description: Continuous analog signals requiring A/D conversion: temperature, pressure, flow, level

items.label: Analog Output
items.description: Analog control output signals: valve position, frequency setpoint

items.label: Digital Input
items.description: Discrete state input signals: limit switch, E-stop, status bit

items.label: Digital Output
items.description: Discrete control output signals: relay control, indicator, solenoid valve

items.label: System Status
items.description: Device runtime status and diagnostics: uptime, communication status, firmware version

items.label: Alarm Summary
items.description: Device alarms and events summary: composite alarm, fault summary

items.label: Calculated
items.description: Not collected from device; derived from other variables via expression: temperature difference, total power, efficiency. No physical address; requires expression and dependency binding
